title: P0 canonical trial identity + P2 fold-consistency enforcement: defects, fixes, and verification
context: Prerequisites to the representative-session downgraded SPK-LFP analysis. Both defects were surfaced by independent verification (independent-verification-behavioral-covariates-20260828.json) as risks; this record establishes what they actually were on real data and what changed.

P0_trial_identity.defect_was_worse_than_reported: The verification flagged trial_num as unsafe FOR JOINS. Direct audit found a second, more damaging consequence: analog._trial_table's drop_duplicates(['trial_num','condition'], keep='first') was SILENTLY DELETING distinct physical trials at ingestion, not merely risking bad joins downstream.

evidence.method: Read raw intervals/omission_glo_passive for all 22 sessions, applied _trial_table's pre-dedup filters verbatim, measured rows collapsed by the dedup key. Bypasses _trial_table itself, so counts are pre-dedup truth rather than a post-hoc consistency check.
evidence.deleted_correct_only_true_PROJECT_DEFAUL: 63 trials across 3 sessions (0.31% corpus-wide): sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec 31 (3.4%), sub-V182o_ses-260629 28 (2.9%), sub-C31o_ses-230901_rec 4 (0.4%).
evidence.deleted_correct_only_false: 264 trials across the same 3 sessions (0.77% corpus-wide).
evidence.collisions_are_distinct_trials_not_dupli: Verified directly on sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec key (trial_num=1, condition=1): two rows at start_time 1372.682767 s and 11773.913700 s -- 2.9 HOURS apart -- with DIFFERENT correct values (1.0 vs 0.0). These are unambiguously different physical events.
evidence.task_block_number_does_not_disambiguate: Identical across colliding rows; unique-key count is 1839 with or without it.
evidence.deletion_was_time_biased: keep='first' applied to a time-ordered table systematically dropped LATER trials in a session rather than a random subset.

fixes.change: Dedup key changed from ['trial_num','condition'] to ['start_time'] (drops genuinely repeated records, preserves distinct trials sharing a trial_num). Canonical trial_id changed from '{stem}|trial={trial_num}|condition={condition}' to '{stem}|t={start_time:.6f}|trial={trial_num}|condition={condition}'. A mechanical guard now RAISES if trial_id is not 1:1 with rows, before comparator expansion.
fixes.behavior_change: STATED AT THE CHANGE SITE. Affected sessions now return MORE trials (previously-deleted ones are restored). Any cached artifact keyed on the old trial_id format, or any count derived from the 3 affected sessions, is stale and must be regenerated.
fixes.microsecond_precision_rationale: Sample periods here are >= 1/30 ms, so 1 us cannot merge two distinct trials; fixed-width formatting keeps ids stable across runs (no float repr drift).

fixes.change: _epoch_grouper grouped by trial_num, feeding raster_plot and psth_analysis. Colliding trial_nums merged physically distinct trials (2.9 h apart) into a single raster row / PSTH trial and undercounted n_trials. Now groups by trial_id when present, else start_time.
fixes.secondary_defect_found_while_fixing: The raster consumer cast the group key via int(float(key)), which a string trial_id would crash on; and string keys sort LEXICOGRAPHICALLY, which is not onset order ('11773.9' < '1372.6') -- verified false on real ids. Groups are now sorted explicitly by onset and the raster emits a 0-based ordinal, preserving the documented int schema while being genuinely unique per physical trial.
fixes.behavior_change: n_trials increases for the 3 affected sessions; raster trial_id is now a time-ordered ordinal rather than the (non-unique) trial_num.

audit_of_other_call_sites.omission/scripts/archive_oneoff/suite_gr: groupby('trial_num') -- archived one-off, NOT fixed, recorded as debt. Not on any live analysis path.
audit_of_other_call_sites.omission/scripts/verify_behavioral_v5_co: merge(on='trial_num') exists but ONLY inside a secondary module_crosscheck block, NOT in the primary analyse_session path. The load-bearing V5 covariation numbers do not pass through it, so the confirmed real-data conclusion is unaffected. The cross-check's own n_matched may be fan-out-inflated; recorded, not corrected.
audit_of_other_call_sites.omission/jnwb_ext/matched_empty.py: trial_index is a within-group enumerate index, already documented (2026-08-27) as unique only within a (condition, omission_slot) group and never to be joined on alone. No bare-key join found. Its p1_onset_s carries the physical trial onset.

verification.tests: omission/tests/test_trial_identity_join_safety.py -- 5 passed. Covers: duplicate trial_num survives the new dedup; canonical trial_id unique across duplicates; a trial_num merge demonstrably FANS OUT (5 rows from 3 trials, 2 pairing different physical trials) while a trial_id merge is exactly 1:1; the uniqueness guard raises; and the invariant n_rows == n_unique(trial_id) holds on the worst real collision session.
verification.real_data_check: sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec, correct_only=True: 921 rows, 921 unique trial_id, 793 unique trial_num -- 128 previously-vulnerable collisions now survive rather than being deleted or merged. Lexicographic-vs-onset ordering mismatch confirmed on real ids (not theoretical).

P2_fold_consistency.defect: The cross-fitting guarantee required estimate_timing_nested and fit_nuisance_tier to receive the SAME n_splits/seed. All 5 call sites were correct, but nothing enforced it: a mismatched seed would silently void cross-fitting with no error and no visible symptom (CONCERN raised by independent verification 2026-08-28).

fix.change: Added folds_fingerprint(n_samples, n_splits, seed) and a _TimingEstimate ndarray subclass that carries the fingerprint of the partition it was cross-fit against. fit_nuisance_tier now RAISES when the timing estimate's partition differs from the one it is about to evaluate on.
fix.compatibility: _TimingEstimate IS an ndarray for all arithmetic/indexing/IO purposes, so every existing caller works unchanged. A plain untagged ndarray is still accepted (nothing can be verified about it either way), so the enforcement is additive rather than breaking.

verification.tests: omission/tests/test_fold_consistency_enforcement.py + existing leakage/scaler suites -- 11 passed. Covers: matching seeds accepted; mismatched seed raises; mismatched n_splits raises; untagged ndarray still accepted; the subclass behaves as a plain ndarray under arithmetic/reshape/mean; fingerprint is deterministic and distinguishes seed, n_splits and n_samples.
verification.behavior_preserving: Timing estimates verified BIT-IDENTICAL to the pre-change code path on a 150-trial case (np.array_equal == True). The change adds detection only; it does not alter any number.

P1_behavioral_qc: IN PROGRESS in a separate workstream; receipt will be behavioral-qc-repair-20260829.json.

open_debt.detail: omission/scripts/archive_oneoff/suite_granger_v1_pfc.py groups by trial_num; archived, not on a live path, not fixed.
verify_behavioral_v5_covariation.py's secondary cross-check merges on trial_num and may report an inflated n_matched. Primary V5 results unaffected.

Any artifact keyed on the OLD trial_id format, or carrying trial counts from sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec / sub-C31o_ses-230901_rec / sub-V182o_ses-260629, predates the P0 fix and is stale. Not enumerated or regenerated here.

does_not_affect: The CONFIRMED causal-identification conclusion (causal-identification-branch-seal-20260828.json). That result rests on synthetic calibration plus real pupil/gaze covariation computed outside the affected join paths. These are data-integrity repairs to machinery needed for the NEXT (downgraded-estimand) analysis.
